\[
D = 6.5 \times 10^{-5} \exp\left(-\frac{136000}{8.314 \times 873.15}\right)

\[
D \approx 6.5 \times 10^{-5} \exp(-18.73)
\]

\[
D \approx 4.7 \times 10^{-13}\ \text{m}^2/\text{s}
\]
